name: WhileStatement
docs:
A `WHILE` statement.

Example:
```sql
WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
BEGIN
   FETCH NEXT FROM c1 INTO @var1, @var2;
END
```

[MsSql](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/sql/t-sql/language-elements/while-transact-sql)
